svg.title: Thinker context removal and API costs
svg.desc: An animated isometric coding agent builds context, then Thinker removes 24,000 tokens from a 65,000-token window. An amber connector links the edited context to a one-time cache rewrite charge. Net savings begin on the third cached-read request after rewriting and reach 9.8 percent after ten requests. All costs are illustrative; the rewrite includes hypothetical rebuild overhead. The animation repeats in 37.7 seconds. Reduced motion shows the final comparison.
